Subject: Redwood Private / VPC - Security discovery & next steps

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to run through Acme's requirements. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard:
- You need a Private/VPC deployment (not public-hosted) with network isolation for PII workloads.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and GDPR controls are required for vendor onboarding; potential HIPAA scope for a sub-set of traffic.
- Your security team wants an option for an air-gapped on-prem deployment for regulated environments, and a VPC pattern for cloud-hosted private installs.

What we are sharing (attached):
1) Redwood SOC 2 summary (current Type II scope and report cadence) — redwood_soc2_summary_2026-03.pdf
2) Draft VPC network diagram illustrating private control plane + customer-managed network peering — redwood_vpc_network_diagram_v1.pdf
3) Starter vendor security questionnaire template for you to pass back — vendor_security_questionnaire_acme.xlsx

Proposed next steps / asks:
- Alice / Security: confirm whether SOC 2 Type II is sufficient initially or if you need our audit artifacts shared through an NDA + portal.
- Please indicate which workloads (by service name) you expect to be in the air-gapped scope vs. VPC scope. This will help us size the on-prem bundle.
- We'll set up a technical session next week with our infra lead to walk the VPC diagram and discuss routing, peering, and key management options (KMS/HSM).

Timeline suggestion: we can have a technical deep-dive on Tue/Wed next week and provide a preliminary deployment estimate within 3 business days after that call.

If it's helpful, I can also provide a short note on our data flows and retention policies for GDPR/HIPAA sign-off.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Marcus — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. A few clarifications from our side:

1) SOC 2: we need evidence of SOC 2 Type II covering the control environment for your hosted control plane. We can start with the SOC 2 summary but will likely request access to the full report under an NDA.
2) GDPR/HIPAA: GDPR controls must be documented (data processor agreements, data subject request handling). HIPAA will be in-scope for a small subset of our customers — we'll need a brief on your encryption at rest/in transit and BAAs if we move forward.
3) Air-gapped: for initial procurement, we'd like to see both options:
   - VPC pattern for cloud-hosted private instances (standard path)
   - Air-gapped on-prem option (for the PHI-containing workloads) — please confirm whether the on-prem package supports fully disconnected deployment and what the uplift is on licensing/support.

Action items from Acme:
- I will gather the list of service names and send them to you by Tues EOD.
- I'll loop in procurement and legal once we confirm the SOC 2 sharing path.

Can we lock a technical session on Tue 23rd at 10:00am PT? That works for our infra folks.

Thanks,
Alice Bennett
Senior Product Security Manager
Acme Corp
alice.bennett@acme-corp.com
